stories.title: USC suspends LB Stephens after ejection for hit on Oregon QB Moore
stories.summary: USC is suspending linebacker Desman Stephens II one game for his conduct in Saturday night's 41-27 loss to Oregon following a late hit on quarterback Dante Moore.

stories.title: Dolphins RB Achane suffers knee injury, won't return vs. Chiefs
stories.summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a knee injury against the Chiefs and was ruled out.

stories.title: Florida jumps to highest ranking since 2020 as Texas solidifies grip on No. 1
stories.summary: Florida made a massive jump in the Associated Press Top 25 and landed in the top 10 for the first time in five years while four teams joined the rankings in a major shuffle.

stories.title: Ravens WR Flowers gets green light to play against Cowboys
stories.summary: Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers will play against the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro after having an encouraging workout before the game.

stories.title: Bears QB Bagent clears protocol, but Keenum expected to start vs. Eagles
stories.summary: The Bears' Tyson Bagent has cleared the concussion protocol, but Case Keenum is expected to start Monday night's game at quarterback against the Eagles.
